name: reconciliation
title: Reconciliation block
description: Match inbound bank credits to expected payments without blurring the two feeds: the credit rows are the integrator's own bank/PSP feed (labelled so), the reference codes are Venly-issued. Sectioned exception queue with zero-counts always drawn, a judging workspace with the received evidence left of the candidates, per-signal match rationale instead of a score, a many-to-one builder with a live difference figure, four peer dispositions, and undo that reopens the expected payment.
